behavior: Module-owned integer/pointer layouts up to 256 bytes lower to exact bounded stack storage, including packed and nested fields with allocation padding.
Flat two-word integer/pointer SSA loads, stores, insertions, extractions and call/return values use private scalar carriers with the existing RAX/RDX ABI.
Shared frame planning preserves instruction-produced values across stores and final-use argument permutations. Global pointer store values materialize through ordinary symbol addresses.
The canonical unchanged Fast capture emits 20 of 34 selected functions and rejects 14; no complete local object or execution is claimed.
known_boundaries: Unresolved, cyclic, over-aligned or oversized layouts, aggregate parameters, unsupported pair users, memory barriers and unsupported ABI annotations retain fail-closed boundaries.

Scalar, switch, indirect-call and stack-argument forms remain ahead of whole-program execution. ReleaseSafe is a separate larger frontier; its previously recorded narrow-checkpoint diagnostic and real stack-probe runtime requirement remain open.
Conservative preservation can introduce frames where some homes already use registers; this checkpoint makes no performance claim.
The full authorized plan continues until unchanged upstream Fibonacci executes its original six assertions in ReleaseFast, ReleaseSafe and ReleaseSmall with LLVM-equivalent exit/stdout/stderr.
